All our lessons are given by certified IKO-instructors. Every student will receive an IKO level certificate after completing their course. The courses will be adjusted for beginners, intermediate and advanced level. This gives every student the opportunity to progress within their own level and pace.</strong></p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div      class="vc_row wpb_row section vc_row-fluid  lessons vc_custom_1550653145237 grid_section" style=' text-align:left;'><div class=" section_inner clearfix"><div class='section_inner_margin clearfix'><div class="lessons1 wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-4"><div class="vc_column-inner vc_custom_1550657706150"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div class="vc_empty_space"  style="height: 75px" >
<span class="vc_empty_space_inner">
<span class="empty_space_image"  ></span>
</span></div><div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  vc_custom_1754901436285"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><h1 class="font_8" style="text-align: center;"><strong><span class="color_16">DISCOVERY</span></strong></h1><h3 class="font_7" style="text-align: center;"><strong><span class="color_16">3 hours course.</span></strong></h3><p class="font_7" style="text-align: center;"><strong><span class="color_16">Two students to one </span><span class="color_16">IKO instructor</span><span class="color_16">.</span></strong></p><p class="font_7" style="text-align: center;"><strong><span class="color_16">This entry level practical based course is aimed at complete beginners to introduce you to the sport of kitesurfing.</span></strong></p><p class="font_7" style="text-align: center;"><strong><span class="color_16">We will cover all the essentials you will need.</span></strong></p><ul style="text-align: center;"><li><strong>General theory</strong></li><li><strong>Safety theory</strong></li><li><strong>Kite set-up and kite maintenance</strong></li><li><strong>Use of safety systems</strong></li><li><strong>Understanding the wind window</strong></li><li><strong>Basic kite flying skills on the beach</strong></li><li><strong>Launching and landing the kite</strong></li><li><strong>Packing up the kite and  the lines</strong></li></ul><p class="font_7"><img data-lazyloaded="1" src="data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyB4bWxucz0iaHR0cDovL3d3dy53My5vcmcvMjAwMC9zdmciIHdpZHRoPSIzMDAiIGhlaWdodD0iMjE0IiB2aWV3Qm94PSIwIDAgMzAwIDIxNCI+PHJlY3Qgd2lkdGg9IjEwMCUiIGhlaWdodD0iMTAwJSIgc3R5bGU9ImZpbGw6I2NmZDRkYjtmaWxsLW9wYWNpdHk6IDAuMTsiLz48L3N2Zz4=" </span></div><div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  vc_custom_1754901458840"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><h1 class="font_8" style="text-align: center;"><strong><span class="color_16">COMPLETE</span></strong></h1><h3 style="text-align: center;">9 hours complete course.</h3><p class="font_7" style="text-align: center;"><strong><span class="color_16">The best way to learn and ride!</span></strong></p><p class="font_7" style="text-align: center;"><strong><span class="color_16">Two students to one IKO instructor.</span></strong></p><p style="text-align: center;"><strong>The first is the same as the 3 hour course.</strong></p><p style="text-align: center;"><strong>3 till 6 hours:</strong></p><ul style="text-align: center;"><li><strong>Kite control from the water.</strong></li><li><strong>Body drag.</strong></li><li><strong>First contact with the board.</strong></li></ul><p style="text-align: center;"><strong>6 till 9 hours:</strong></p><ul class="wpb_wrapper"><div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  vc_custom_1674991856951"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><h2 style="text-align: center;"><strong style="font-weight: 600;">RENT KITESURF EQUIPMENT AT KITESURF TOFO.</strong></h2><p style="text-align: center;"><strong style="font-weight: 600;">We have different sizes of kites and boards suited for all the conditions here in Mozambique</strong></p><p style="text-align: center;"><strong style="font-weight: 600;">Kitesurf Tofo is specialist in lightwind kitesurfing, we offer hydrofoils, foilkites and big sizes of boards and tubekites.</strong></p><p style="text-align: center;"><strong style="font-weight: 600;">But when the wind is pumping you can take a small size!</strong></p><p style="text-align: center;"><strong style="font-weight: 600;">&#8211; Kite directly in the bay at Tofo for small waves.</strong></p><p style="text-align: center;"><strong style="font-weight: 600;">&#8211; Go to Tofinho beach for big waves.</strong></p><p style="text-align: center;"><strong style="font-weight: 600;">&#8211; Kitesurf at the lagoon at Barra for flat water conditions.</strong></p><p style="text-align: center;"><strong style="font-weight: 600;">If you want to rent at Kitesurf Tofo you will need to bring something to proof that you can kitesurf to a safe standard.</strong></p><p style="text-align: center;"><strong style="font-weight: 600;">A certificate from any recognised kite organization and your passport will do.</strong></p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p style="text-align: center;"><strong style="font-weight: 600;">Need help with planning your trip&#8230;</strong></p><p style="text-align: center;"><strong style="font-weight: 600;">&#8211; <span style="color: #ff6600;"> <a href="https://eng.windfinder.com/forecast/tofo">weather conditions</a></span></strong></p><p style="text-align: center;"><strong style="font-weight: 600;">&#8211; <span style="color: #ff6600;"> <a href="http://www.surf-forecast.com/breaks/Praia-Tofo/seatemp">water conditions</a></span></strong></p><p style="text-align: center;"><strong style="font-weight: 600;">&#8211;
